_comment: Hand-written Hindi for the strings HikaShop has no word for. Merged over the ones taken from
HikaShop's own hi-IN file by tools/build-locales.mjs, so regenerating keeps these.
Hindi counts in two, and Intl treats 0 as one as well, so both forms have to read naturally
with any number in front of them.
Devanagari; the first catalogue here in that script.
Polite address (आप), matching the tone of the HikaShop backend.
